_comment: Copy this file to config.json (install.sh does it for you) and put your REAL proxies below. config.json is gitignored — never commit credentials.

icon._comment: Any SF Symbol name. Run make_icon.py with no args to render a palette of candidates. point 15-18, weight regular/medium.

proxies.name: work-https
proxies._note: HTTPS proxy = TLS to the proxy itself. Add "insecure": true if it has a self-signed cert.

proxies.name: direct
proxies._note: Empty url = no upstream, connect straight out.
